method: Independent original-image comparison of all eight actual/reference pairs. This report records the already completed inspection; no repeated GUI action, test, screenshot alteration or source edit.

corrections.observed: Recovery action buttons are rounded capsules in the actual compact layout; graphite reference uses small rectangular corners. This is a visual style mismatch independent of the dark/light condition difference.
corrections.sourceBasis: file-recovery.css fixed21px radius overrides the compact button rule.
corrections.status: accepted for next unified build; no new-package visual proof yet

corrections.observed: The same active file remains in the editor, but changing layout narrows the tab viewport without bringing its tab back into view. Iris clips the label at the right edge; sand hides the active tab entirely to the right.

locations.iris/G02: Upper-right file tab strip: only the beginning of missing-link.ts is visible before the tab viewport ends.
locations.sand/G02: Upper file tab strip ends visibly at text-101MiB.txt; missing-link.ts remains the central active file but its tab is offscreen to the right.

corrections.sourceBasis: EditorWorkbench.tsx activeTab scroll effect depends only on buffer.key.
corrections.minimalSuggestion: Re-scroll the active tab when the tab-strip width changes; preserve editor state and clean up the observer.
corrections.status: accepted for next unified build; no new-package visual proof yet
